audio.text: Do you happen to know if the résumé workshop is still on?

options: As far as I know, nothing has changed.
I happened to see her at the café earlier.
My résumé is still two pages long.
It's on the table by the front door.

why.en: Indirect "yes": nothing has changed, so the workshop is still happening. B repeats "happen"; C repeats "résumé" and "still"; D takes "on" literally.
why.tr: Dolaylı "evet": hiçbir şey değişmemiş, yani atölye yapılıyor. B "happen" kelimesini tekrar ediyor; C "résumé" ve "still" kelimelerini tekrar ediyor; D "on" kelimesini gerçek anlamıyla alıyor.
why.es: Un "sí" indirecto: nada ha cambiado, así que el taller sigue en pie. B repite "happen"; C repite "résumé" y "still"; D toma "on" en sentido literal.
